PrivacyRtntStoreDelStatus.name: PrivacyRtntStoreDelStatus
PrivacyRtntStoreDelStatus.description: Represents the status of retention store deletion operations in Privacy Center.

Name.description: Assigned automatically when each retention store deletion status record is inserted. It can't be set directly, and it can't be modified after the record is created.

ObjectState.description: Stores state information for the deletion operation.

PrivacyRetentionStatus.description: The current status of the retention store deletion operation.

PrivacyRetentionStoreType.description: The type of retention store being tracked for deletion.

RetentionStoreOrganizationId.description: The ID of the Organization associated with this retention store deletion operation. This is a relationship field.
